description_en: Queries the status of the multi-account management feature
name: DescribeRdStatus

CurrentUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the current account

CurrentUidType.description_en:
The type of the Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

MasterAccount: management account.

DelegatedAdminAccount: delegated administrator account.

MemberAccount: member
CurrentUidType.description_zh:
账号类型。取值：

MasterAccount：表示管理账号
DelegatedAdminAccount：表示委托管理账号
MemberAccount：表示成员账号

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the multi-account management feature is enabled for Anti-DDoS Origin
Enabled.description_zh: 是否允许使用原生防护多账号管理

LocalEnable.description_en: Indicates whether the multi-account management feature is enabled for the current account in Anti-DDoS Origin
LocalEnable.description_zh: 当前账号是否开通了原生防护多账号管理

MasterUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the management account in the resource directory
MasterUid.description_zh: 资源目录的管理账号 (Master Account) ID

RemoteEnable.description_en: Indicates whether Resource Directory is enabled in the Resource Management console (https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com)
RemoteEnable.description_zh: 是否在资源管理控制台 (https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com)开通了资源目录

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的 ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RootUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the management account for which the multi-account management feature is enabled in Anti-DDoS Origin
RootUid.description_zh: 原生防护多账号管理的管理账号 ID

ServicePrincipalEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether the trusted service is enabled
